articles.title: Energy demand hits yearly high on continued heat wave
articles.description: Korea recorded the highest electricity demand for the year in recent days amid a prolonged heat wave, industry data showed Sunday. The country's maximum electricity demand reached 95.321 gigawatts on Friday, according to data from the Korea Power Exchange (KPX). The reserve capacity stood at 8.2 gigawatts. articles.title: Study shows gap between ideal, actual number of children among Koreans
articles.description: About seven out of 10 Koreans regard having at least two children as ideal but many end up having just one due to financial burdens and other factors, a study showed Sunday.
